purpose: First separately frozen cross-architecture comparison; not a replacement for prior studies
subject: conv_seed17_validation_selected_epoch89

full_predicates: absent from frozen prior verification index union
smoke_predicates: present in frozen prior verification index union

request.input_semantics: torch default float64 before ToTensor; [0,1] clipped box; identical materialized tensor file per input across arms
request.property: all nine true-class margins positive on every tie-legal reachable pair

crown.name: ACT route frontend + plain CROWN whole-box variable-weight static pairs

execution.order: input-blocked; cyclic rotations of [adaptive, monolithic, crown] by rank modulo 3
execution.input_materialization: separately timed and equally excluded; no cached route or proof facts
execution.timeouts: kill owned request process group; retain terminal and prelude snapshots; no late result promotion
execution.errors: fail-stop, retain failed attempt and unattempted inventory; no sample replacement
execution.smoke_gate: all six terminals structurally audited; each arm has at least one complete non-error package/record; no positive-count or effect-size requirement
execution.full_launch: requires a separate execution instruction after orchestrator/auditor integration and passing smoke

analysis.primary: adaptive versus matched monolithic paired SAFE indicator difference on 30 inputs
analysis.external: complete-request HZ-policy positives versus CROWN numerical positives, with evidence levels kept separate
report: gained and lost solved for HZ arms
analysis.denominator: 30 distinct inputs per arm; errors/timeouts remain; incomplete run reports unattempted separately and has no completed-cohort conclusion

statistics.resampling_unit: input with all three arms retained

limitations: one new architecture and one training seed
clean-correct subset is not full-test certified accuracy
matched monolithic is not the legacy strong configuration or all possible monolithic solvers
CROWN is not a full dynamic-model independent verifier or formal SAFE
no cross-architecture superiority claim before paired outcomes
